why: Makes the button's visibility a claim recomputed only at a surface change, while the signal it depends on is pushed between them. A win records an unlock and the page repaints the Levels grid from it, so a session that reaches its first multi-level offer at the moment it ends leaves the button hidden on the very screen the player is looking at, until some later `setState` -- by which time they have left. The same reasoning is already written on `setLevelSelect`'s `applyTitleAffordances` call for the Main Menu's own copy of this button.
killedBy: hud: every ending gets its own screen (issue #323) withholds Choose Level from a session with no level to choose
